item.title: Elkhart County Parks hosts monthly Wednesday Bird Walk
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Elkhart County Parks invites the community to celebrate a Wednesday Bird Walk on Mar. 4 beginning at 8 a.m. at the Baintertown Dam in River Preserve County Park.

item.title: Local politicians react to strike on Iran
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Local politicians and community leaders took to social media to share their reaction to the United States' military operations after the United States and Israel launched a major joint strike on Iran.

item.title: Heisman winner Fernando Mendoza headlines combine; Jadarian Price touts ‘four-down’ skill set
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Interviews gave way to on-field workouts Saturday at the NFL scouting combine, where several Big Ten standouts set early benchmarks and a Heisman Trophy winner commanded the spotlight without taking a snap.

item.title: Epic Dance Studios announces new weekly dance classes
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Epic Dance Studios has announced they will be offering weekly dance classes at the Tolson Center beginning Mar. 4.

item.title: One person injured after crashing into utility pole in Elkhart
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- A 2004 Lexus RX 330 was traveling eastbound on C.R. 6 west of C.R. 11 in Elkhart on Saturday, Feb. 28 at approximately 5:39 p.m.

item.title: Hoosier Valley Railroad Museum invites families to ride Easter Trains
item.description: NORTH JUDSON, Ind. -- The Hoosier Valley Railroad Museum is running their annual Easter Trains through the Northwest Indiana countryside.

item.title: Bethel University hosts South Bend Regional College Fair
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Bethel University will be hosting the South Bend Regional College Fair on Tuesday, Mar. 17, from 10 a.m. to 11:30 p.m. in the gates Gymnasium on Bethel's campus.

item.title: Second Annual Coldest Night of the Year raises over 40 thousand in Benton Harbor
item.description: BENTON HARBOR, Mich. -- More than 100 people took to the sidewalks Saturday for the second annual Coldest Night of the Year 5K in Benton Harbor, raising more than $40,000 to support local emergency shelter services and raise awareness about housing insecurity.

item.title: South Bend Museum of Art showcases students' art at annual art exhibition
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The South Bend Museum of Art held the 2026 Scholastic Art Award Exhibition on Saturday, Feb. 28.
